title: AI-Assisted Interpersonal Communication
context: Collaborative project with Professor Angel Hsing-Chi Hwang at USC
methods: Theory-driven coding of chatbot conversations, interviews, and open-ended responses; mixed-effects analyses of pre–post measures.
limitation: These reported directions do not establish improved independent competence, lasting dependence, or a causal loss of agency. No effect sizes or significance claims are displayed.
source: The existing research case and downloadable case summary, verified against repository commit 5bec755e4ae19ee453b4d815a42fe4e141e9abf7. Raw data and inferential statistics were not supplied for this website update.
